title: John Van Fleet
description: "The kid in me will always remember the sound of a battle taking place in the vacuum of deep space," observes John Van Fleet. Van Fleet's published works include numerous stories for HELLRAISER as well as a book entitled PRIMAL and several adaptations for THE RAY BRADBURY CHRONICLES. He collaborated with writer John Reiber on a six-part story called SHADOWS FALL for DC Comics' Vertigo line. This latest effort will be released sometime in 1993.
